spells.notes: Promoted from 체신부차관 in the 7·13 개각 of 1987. The reshuffle was announced on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 and the new ministers received the 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14, the date on the MSIT list and the archived 정보통신부 list. The start follows the 임명장 day (see issues), so 1987-07-13 is the alternative. 전두환-era minister in office on 1988-02-25. The 5th Republic cabinet handed in blanket resignations after its last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 중앙일보 1988-02-25, 매일경제 1988-02-25). He had been named for the first 노태우 cabinet on 1988-02-19 and received a new 임명장 on 1988-02-25, so the tenure is split at that date, as the finance, justice, foreign and interior files do for the other retained ministers. spells.notes: Former 내무부차관 and 전남지사, appointed in the 12·27 개각 of 1990. Retained through the reshuffles of 1991-05, 1991-12, 1992-03 and 1992-06 and in the 중립내각 of 1992-10-09, when the resignations of the retained ministers were returned (see continuity). He stayed past the end of 노태우's term and left on 1993-02-26, the day the first 김영삼 cabinet was named and given the 임명장 (중앙일보 1993-02-27 '26일 체신부장관에서 퇴임'). 매일경제 1993-02-24 reports the 총무처 view that the ministers would hand over when successors were appointed. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 instead says the outgoing cabinet's resignations were all accepted on 02-25, hence medium confidence. The MSIT list and ko.wikipedia give 1993-02-25. The archived 정보통신부 page prints '1993년 3월 25일', which its own duration '(2년2월)' contradicts. Hanja 宋彥鍾 as printed in 동아일보 1990-12-27. The variant form 宋彦鍾 also appears in print (조선일보 1992-10-20, see continuity). spells.notes: Career 체신 official, promoted from 체신부차관 into the first 김영삼 cabinet on 1993-02-26 (named and given the 임명장 that afternoon). Retained in the 12·21 개각 of 1993 and through the changes of 1994-04 and 1994-10 (see continuity). This spell ends with 체신부 on 1994-12-22. 정부조직법 법률 제4831호 renamed the ministry 정보통신부 on its promulgation on 1994-12-23, and its 부칙 제2조① deems 체신부 officials to be 정보통신부 officials, so he continued as 정보통신부장관 for that day (next spell). spells.notes: One-day continuation under 법률 제4831호 부칙 제2조①. For the merged ministries that clause carries over only officials other than 정무직 ('정무직을 제외한'), but for 체신부 it carries over all officials. The act passed the Assembly on the morning of 1994-12-23, was signed at 14:00 and promulgated in the 관보 that day. At 15:00 the reshuffle naming 경상현 was announced, and 윤동윤 held his 이임식 at 16:00 (전자신문 1994-12-24). The end is that day. The successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24, which is the alternative end (see issues). The MSIT list and the archived 정보통신부 page also end his term on 1994-12-23 but list him only under 체신부. He was not reappointed on the reorganization. Personal data as for the previous spell.

issues.desc: 최영철 end date. The MSIT 역대장관 page, the archived 정보통신부 pages (Korean '1988년 12월 5월 1989년 7월 8일', English 'Dec. 5, 1988 ~ Jul. 8, 1989') and ko.wikipedia end his term on 1989-07-08, which would imply a 체신부 vacancy from 1989-07-09 to 07-18. Same-week reports contradict this. He presided over the ITU 관리이사국 자축회 on 07-11 (매일경제 1989-07-11, 한국일보 1989-07-12) and received the Argentine ambassador on 07-13 as 체신부장관 (동아일보 1989-07-13, 한국경제 1989-07-14), and every report of the 7·19 개각 names him the sitting 체신부장관 moved to 노동부. The file uses 1989-07-19 and records no vacancy. The official lists appear to have copied an error.

Start-date convention. No gazette file exists before 2001. When a reshuffle was announced on one day and the 임명장 given the next, the start is the 임명장 day, as in the finance, science and interior ext88 files and as the MSIT list prints. This affects 오명 1987-07-14 (announced 07-13), 경상현 1994-12-24 (announced 12-23) and 이석채 1995-12-21 (announced 12-20). The 1998 holdover 강봉균, copied unchanged from ict.verified.json, starts on the announcement day 1996-08-08 (임명장 1996-08-09, 매일경제 1996-08-10 and 한국경제 1996-08-10). This file ends 이석채 on 1996-08-08 to avoid an overlap. If one rule (임명장 day) is applied across lineages, 강봉균's start and 이석채's end both move to 1996-08-09, and the science lineage's 구본영 moves with them. The holdover was not changed here.

End dates on reshuffle days split by a night. Where the outgoing minister's 이임식 is reported on the announcement day and the successor's 임명장 came the next morning, this file ends the spell on the 이임식 day. This applies to 윤동윤 (이임식 16:00 on 1994-12-23, 전자신문 1994-12-24) and 경상현 (이임식 13:30 on 1995-12-20, 경향신문 1995-12-21). The alternative is the successor's 임명장 day (1994-12-24 and 1995-12-21). Other ext88 files differ on this point (interior ends 최형우 on the successor's day despite a 1994-12-23 이임식, culture ends 이민섭 on his 이임식 day). One rule across lineages would be better.

1994-12-23 reorganization. 윤동윤's tenure is split into 체신부 (to 1994-12-22) and a one-day 정보통신부 spell (1994-12-23, reorg_continuation true, reappointed_on_reorg false), following the office dates in offices_1988.json and the treatment of 박윤흔 (환경처 to 환경부) in environment.ext88.json. 법률 제4831호 부칙 제2조① deems all 체신부 officials to be 정보통신부 officials, while for the merged ministries it excludes 정무직. The act took effect on promulgation in the afternoon of 1994-12-23, and his 이임식 followed at 16:00. If the researcher prefers not to count a same-day continuation as a spell, drop spell 7 and end the 체신부 spell on 1994-12-23.

1993 transition. 송언종's end is 1993-02-26, supported by 중앙일보 1993-02-27 ('26일 체신부장관에서 퇴임') and the same-day appointment of 윤동윤. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 says the outgoing cabinet's resignations were all accepted on 02-25, and the MSIT list and ko.wikipedia give 1993-02-25, hence medium confidence. The archived 정보통신부 page prints '1993년 3월 25일' with the duration '(2년2월)', a typo for February.

1988-02-25 split. 오명 is split into a 전두환 spell (1987-07-14..1988-02-25, resigned) and a 노태우 spell from 1988-02-25. The 5th Republic cabinet's blanket resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and the retained ministers received new 임명장 that day, as the finance, justice, foreign and interior files record for their retained ministers. The official lists and ko.wikipedia show one continuous tenure (1987-07-14 to 1988-12-04).

Retentions without a new appointment. In the 3·17 개각 of 1990 and the 중립내각 of 1992-10-09 the whole cabinet handed in resignations and the retained ministers stayed. For 1992-10-09 the reports say their resignations were returned (매일경제 and 중앙일보 1992-10-09). For 1990-03 no report of a new 임명장 for retained ministers was found. Both are treated as continuous tenures (이우재, 송언종).

Identity. 이우재 (李祐在, born 1934, 11th NA per ko.wikipedia) is not the 이우재 in na_members_12_22.csv (李佑宰, born 1936-09-13, 15th and 16th NA for 서울 금천구). An assembler that joins by name alone would link them wrongly. 최영철 in this file (崔永喆, born 1935-12-19) is the same person as the 노동부장관 of 1989-1990 (labor lineage) and the 부총리 겸 통일원장관 of 1992-1993 (unification lineage).

Personal data. 이석채 has only a birth year because ko.wikipedia (1945-10-16) and Wikidata (1945-09-11) disagree. 경상현 has only a birth year (1937) in both. 송언종's day of birth rests on ko.wikipedia alone. Gender for 윤동윤 comes from a newspaper profile, since Wikidata has no P21. English names follow the archived 정보통신부 English pages (2003), rewritten as family name then given name.

Holdover check. The 1998 holdover 강봉균 (copied from ict.verified.json with from_main true) agrees with the sources read here for its start, apart from the convention question above. No tier 1-3 evidence against the record was found. No acting heads are recorded because the chain has no vacancy days in 1988-02-25..1998-02-24.
